feeding_claim.verbatim: In an ideal system, animals are nourished naturally on vegetative forages, humanely handled, and butchered locally.

notes: Cattle company with a butchery in Kapolei on Oahu. The site labels its beef Pasture Raised, Grassfed, and Rotationally Grazed but gives no grass-finishing claim, so the category is kept at grass-fed. Select products are sold online through shop.kunoacattle.com; beef is also carried in many Hawaii supermarkets (Times, Don Quijote, Kokua Market, Big Save, Safeway, commissaries and others) and restaurants across the islands. The where-to-buy page also mentions pork, but whether Kunoa raises the pork itself is unclear, so only beef is listed. Certified Animal Welfare Approved by AGW per A Greener World's own Hawaii producer listing. No shipping area named and no quarter, half, or whole shares found.
